_about: Workshop's reviews (Roadmap item 46, Brett's picks on docs/mockups/review-catalog/, version 6, Nov 25): written once as templates, each product filling in its own (app/data/review_fills.json for askdnd). bucket: one of BUCKETS; cadence: Brett's pick (weekly, monthly, phase, on_demand, off); launch: what Run asks first (now: one confirm; polish: the area, then a focus and devices; dig: the feature, what prompted it, what to check against and with whom, then Start); limit: minutes before a run stops and reports what it covered; skip_unchanged: a scheduled run with no merged change since the last run is skipped and says so.

buckets.title: Experience
buckets.question: Is {product} easy and pleasant to use?
buckets.automatic: Layout tests at every width, iPhone Safari nightly, the Monday phone sweep, the visual compare before a merge.

buckets.title: Correctness
buckets.question: Is what {product} says right?
buckets.automatic: The nightly live test on the real D&D Beyond, the daily D&D Beyond drift check, the rules and parser tests.

buckets.title: The code
buckets.question: Is it well built, and still easy to change?
buckets.automatic: Tests on every push, the code review on every pull request, the fire drill, Dependabot.

buckets.title: Trust
buckets.question: Is what people give {product} safe?
buckets.automatic: The refusal and reading tests on every route, the public-repo check, the monthly restore drill.

buckets.title: Running it
buckets.question: Is it up, quick and affordable?
buckets.automatic: Sentry errors filed daily, the slowest pages weekly, backups nightly, the after-deploy check, the spending limit.

buckets.title: How we work
buckets.question: Is the way we build {product} working?
buckets.automatic: The daily feedback check, the gaps check at the end of every turn.

reviews.title: Play a game night
reviews.gets: Battle, Sheet, Party and rolls used as the table would
reviews.does: The pages the table plays on, used as a player and the DM would on a game night: laptop first, then a phone.
reviews.built_from: The UI and UX review (Nov 16) and the usability round

reviews.title: Polish an area
reviews.gets: One area's every page made one piece, and usable by everyone
reviews.does: One area's every page against the design system and its purpose, and whether everyone can use it (keyboard, contrast, text size); rounds of picks until it's one piece.
reviews.built_from: The Backstage design review (Nov 24), with the accessibility check

reviews.title: Check every number
reviews.gets: Every number and button checked against the books and each sheet
reviews.does: Every number and button on the main play page checked twice: against the books' own words, and against each character's sheet.
reviews.built_from: The roll audit (Nov 10) and the bridge review (Nov 3)

reviews.title: Dig into a feature
reviews.gets: One feature taken all the way down: why it misbehaves, against the books and the sheet
reviews.does: One feature taken all the way down against the real thing, starting from its open issues or what you wrote.

reviews.title: Go over the week
reviews.gets: The week's changes checked as one, and the guides against them
reviews.does: The week's changes checked as one by fresh reviewers (design system, code), a sweep of every page, and Help, the FAQ, the guides and the tour against what changed.
reviews.built_from: The end-of-day audit (Nov 25), with the Help and guides check

reviews.title: Rethink the build
reviews.gets: Would we build it the same, knowing what we know now
reviews.does: Knowing every requirement now, would we build it differently? What to keep, change and plan.

reviews.title: Test the tests
reviews.gets: Whether the tests still catch planted bugs, and which are slow or flaky
reviews.does: Do the tests still catch what they should: planted bugs (mutation testing), tests that pass only on a second try, slow ones, untested corners.

reviews.title: Check who sees what
reviews.gets: Who sees what, what a request can change, what's kept and where
reviews.does: Read as an attacker and an auditor would: who sees what, what a request can change, what leaves the product; and what's kept, where and how long.
reviews.built_from: The outside review (Nov 10), with the data and retention check

reviews.title: Check it runs well
reviews.gets: Errors, slow pages, failed jobs and the month's costs in one look
reviews.does: Errors, slow pages, failed jobs and the month's costs in one look, with what to change.

reviews.title: Look back at how we work
reviews.gets: Where time went, what fell through, and whether the Roadmap still fits
reviews.does: Where time went, what fell through, what waited on whom, what to change in Workshop; and the Roadmap: items gone stale, scopes waiting, whether the order still matches what matters.
reviews.built_from: The Found, Fixed, Tried audit (Nov 17), with the Roadmap check
